commitMessage: governance: restore consumption coherence across the R7 maintenance programs

cohortSelfExclusion.reason: The consumption record cannot hash its own final bytes; its identity is bound by the authority and manifest instead.

cohort.reason: Re-issue so this record certifies the final bytes of its own cohort. Its runner and test entries were certified before the canonical-authority-binding program lawfully rewrote those two files, which left the record describing bytes that no longer exist. A consumption record has no canonical predecessor and cannot be edited in place, so it is withdrawn and re-issued; it was never committed, so no history is rewritten.

Re-issue for the same reason one level up: this record certifies the R7 historical permanence consumption record, which the canonical-authority-binding program lawfully re-issued. Nothing certifies this record in turn, so the chain closes here.
Single-use successor LOCAL_EXPLICIT_AUTHORITY closing the consumption-coherence chain; no already-consumed authority is reused.
Exact finite five-path cohort with declared per-path pre-state; no wildcard and no directory blanket.
